description.text: Electrical engineering is a discipline centered around electrical energy and its related technologies. It mainly studies the generation, transmission, distribution, utilization, and control of electrical energy. Here is a detailed introduction: Professional History: In 1878, the world's first electrical engineering program was established at Imperial College London. The earliest electrical engineering program in China can be traced back to 1908, when Nanyang University Hall, the predecessor of Jiaotong University, set up an electrical engineering specialty.Training Objectives: To cultivate talents with basic theoretical knowledge in engineering and relevant professional knowledge centered on the production, transmission and utilization of electrical energy, who can effectively apply the knowledge they have learned to solve engineering problems and construct engineering systems, and possess good social ethics and comprehensive qualities.Curriculum: General courses include calculus, linear algebra, electromagnetism, etc. Subject foundation courses include basic engineering graphics, fundamentals of circuits and electronics, electromagnetic fields, etc. Professional courses cover circuit theory, electrical machinery, power system analysis, power system relay protection, etc.Main Directions: Including electrical theory and new technologies, electrical machines and appliances, power systems and their automation, power electronics and grid connection of new energy, etc. Electrical theory and new technologies mainly study electrical networks, biological electromagnetism, etc.; Electrical machines and appliances focus on mechanical-electrical power systems and their control, motor design, etc.; Power systems and automation focus on power system operation and analysis, high-voltage direct current transmission technology, etc.; Power electronics and grid connection of new energy mainly study power electronic converters, new energy power systems, etc.Employment Directions: Graduates can work in the fields of power, energy, manufacturing, communication, etc., in positions such as power system design, operation and maintenance, intelligent grid management, automation control system design. They can also apply to relevant civil service positions such as the Central Committee of the Communist Party of China, Ministry of Transport, National Energy Administration, etc.

duration.text: The Electrical Engineering at Chang'an University is a 3 Years long program for international students, taught in English.

fees.text: Application Fee: $ 200 USD Service Fee: $ 50 USD Tuition fee: $ 2916 USD/per year ￥ 21000 CNY/per year

materials.text: On the application system of our university, applicants must fill in information in Chinese or English and submit application materials online.1. Valid Ordinary Passport.If the applicant is in China, a valid residence permit is also required.2. The highest degree certificate. Graduating students can provide a pre-graduation letter as a substitute, and have to bring the original certificate when they come to China.3. Transcripts.4. "Physical Examination Record for Foreigners"(Attachment 3).Applicants should strictly follow the items required in the "Physical Examination Records for Foreigners" and fill them out in Chinese or English. The “Physical Examination Record for Foreigners” missing pages or without a photo or a cross-page seal on it, or without a signature of physician or seal from hospital is invalid. Whereas the inspection results are valid in 6 months, applicants are requested to determine the time of their medical examination accordingly.5. Valid non-criminal record certificate within 6 months. If the applicant is already in China, she/he can only provide performance letter or Non-objection certificate from current university.6. Proof of Language Proficiency.7. Study Plan for Bachelor or Research Plan for Master and PhD.8. Two recommendation letters signed by (associate) professors (Undergraduate students are exempt).9. Conditional acceptance letter (It’s not a mandatory but a preferred file, with which students will be admitted in priority).10. Others preferred: academic achievements (important), certificates of sports or cultural activity.11. Students under 18 years old should upload Letter of Authorization.(Attachment 4)Note: Chinese or English translation copy is mandatory if original file is not in Chinese/English/Spanish.

requirements.text: 1. Non-Chinese citizens, in good health; 2. Requirements for the applicant's educational background and age: Those who are pursuing a bachelor's degree must have a high school diploma and be under the age of 25. (2) Those who are pursuing a master's degree must have a bachelor's degree and be under the age of 35. (3) Those pursuing a doctoral degree must hold a master's degree and be under the age of 40. (4) Those pursuing non-degree education courses should be under the age of 45. 3. Not a recipient of any other scholarships. 4. Language proficiency requirements: IELTS >= 6.0, TOEFL > 80, MELAB >= 10
